notes.title: Patch Notes 02-05-2023
notes.notes:
We have been beavering away on improvements for The Last Worker and have now pushed these live.

Patch notes: 

VR (all platforms): Stick updated to move instead of Strafe
Index: Touchpad UI added for Strafe
All platforms: Changed Chinese Simplified/Traditional text
All platforms: Added fixes for players getting stuck after the Last Activist in Ground Zero
All platforms: Changing level during pod charge caused UI to remain off in new level

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40196698/100a3d3d13de00f9391e80881c2b1714ebf0a2de.png[/img]

Fill in this form and we can look at any issues that may have arisen.

notes.title: The Last Worker Patch 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40196698/1f32a68564e80f472f1b89a687aecb8788446d1f.png[/img]

Howdy loyal [strike]Consumers[/strike] Jüngle employees! A brand new update for The Last Worker is now available to download - featuring fixes for a couple of achievements that were not behaving properly, Improvements in boost performance for those in VR and better communication of the controls - and more!

The full patch notes are available here :

• Fixed achievements "Try Me", "Gotta Collect Them All", "Good Santa", and "Saboteur". If you've already completed the requirements for these achievements, they will unlock automatically when you next load the game!

• VR - Improved the way the "boost" mechanic functions while in "strafe" mode.

• VR - Improved signposting around the "boost" mechanic.

• SteamVR - Improved calibration and recentering for some headsets that may have been encountering issues. Pressing the recentre button from the SteamVR dashboard will now recalibrate the players height and position in game.

• Implemented experimental Steam VR support on the Epic and GOG builds of the game! Make sure you have SteamVR and the Oculus app installed, then launch the game with the command line argument "-VR". You do not need Steam running to launch with SteamVR!

• Additional minor bugfixes.

[strike]• Pay Rise for Jüngle Employees[/strike]

Note that the achievement fixes should be retroactive - and any that you had previously met the criteria for should unlock upon launching the game after downloading the update.

Thank you once again for you feedback, suggestions and notification of bugs as you find them - please continue to let us know if you come across anything that doesn't behave correctly and we'll have the team look at it ASAP.

Anyway, that's enough slacking around for now - you've got some packages to deliver, get to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40196698/7154f177adec11a08426e5ce3fbc47ea7decb698.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Last Worker : Release date Update
notes.notes:
Attention all Jüngle personnel 

There are companies out there that force their workers to pee in bottles or run the risk of getting fired. Like the Jüngle corporation in our entirely fictitious and not-at-all-inspired-by-real-life game.

But not us.

Together, Writer/Director Jörg Tittel at Oiffy, Ryan Bousfield and his team at Wolf & Wood and Publisher Wired Productions have decided to honour the vision for The Last Worker, and to do so in a humane manner.

The decision has been made to delay the October 19th PC launch to Q1 2023.

The whole team promises a narrative adventure unlike any you’ve played before, featuring a diverse and stellar cast and a host of world class artists and musicians.

The new targeted release window will also allow for a simultaneous release across all platforms, including PC, PC VR, Meta Quest 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Everyone working on The Last Worker would like to thank fans for their continued support as well as the press for the phenomenal reactions to the recent Steam demo and Nintendo Switch hands-on at Gamescom. The enthusiasm and feedback continue to inspire the team and give everyone involved energy for the final stretch.

We can’t wait to welcome you to JFC-1. But please Don’t forget to wash your hands.
